title: Libby clinical-evidence row
description: Row per published clinical-evidence finding. Appended by clinician agent. Per-manuscript decision-relevant fields modeled on the io-shieldbreak pharmacodynamic-results table layout.

intervention_id.description: Stable kebab-case ID grouping rows that share an intervention; PI uses to aggregate across rows.

intervention_dose.description: Dose / schedule as published (e.g. 'cabozantinib 60 mg PO daily', '10 mg IV q2w with 1 mg step-up'). Null if not reported.

population_detail.description: Subset / biomarker / prior-therapy details that scope the cohort. e.g. 'EGFR-mut + MET amp post-osimertinib', 'ECOG 0-1 only'.

design.description: RCT, single-arm phase 2, basket, retrospective cohort, etc.

comparator.description: — for single-arm; named comparator for RCTs.

outcome.description: Free-text outcome name; e.g. 'ORR (BICR)', 'median PFS', 'OS HR vs comparator'.

endpoint_type.description: Endpoint family for sortability and grouping in the rendered table.

variance_or_ci.description: Free-text variance description when numeric CI bounds are not separable (e.g. 'IQR 1.5-4.2').

median_dor_or_pfs.description: Durability — median DoR / PFS / time-on-treatment as reported. e.g. 'mDoR 7.0 mo', 'mPFS 3.6 mo'.

safety_summary.description: 1-2 line summary: G3+ AE rate, treatment-related deaths, characteristic AEs (CRS, ILD, neuropathy, etc).

toxicities.description: Structured per-AE rows for the master manuscripts table. Capture decision-relevant toxicities: high-grade events, characteristic class effects, treatment-discontinuation drivers, AEs flagged in `preferences.toxicity_vetoes`. Multiple grade rows for the same term are allowed (e.g. one row for 'any grade', one for '>=3').

term.description: AE term, CTCAE-aligned where possible. e.g. 'CRS', 'ILD/pneumonitis', 'hand-foot reaction', 'hypertension'.

grade.description: Grade scope: 'any' | '1-2' | '>=3' | '3' | '4' | '5'. Use '>=3' for the union grade-3-5 rate.

n_events.description: Number of patients with the event. Null when only a percentage is reported.

denominator.description: Cohort size for this rate. If omitted, the row-level `n` is assumed.

rate_pct.description: Frequency as percent. Capture exactly as reported.

risk_of_bias.description: Per-paper RoB call. Use RoB2 for RCTs, ROBINS-I for non-randomized, informal for narrative-style review.

case_match.description: How well does this paper's population match the patient profile? `strong` = same indication + line + biomarker. `partial` = same indication, different line/biomarker subset. `weak` = same drug class only. `cross_tumor_only` = different tumor type, included for mechanism/efficacy precedent.
